description: Source code for a Python language generator class used in Playwright's code generation, including methods for generating Python test scripts, handling actions, and formatting code.

classes.name: PythonLanguageGenerator
classes.description: Implements a language generator for Python in Playwright, capable of generating test scripts, actions, and configuration code.

classes.name: PythonFormatter
classes.description: Helper class for formatting Python code with proper indentation and structure.

methods.name: generateAction
methods.description: Generates Python code for a given action in the context of Playwright test recording.

methods.name: _generateActionCall
methods.description: Creates specific Python code snippets for different user actions like click, fill, navigate, etc.

methods.name: generateHeader
methods.description: Generates the header part of the Python test script, including imports and setup.

methods.name: generateFooter
methods.description: Generates the footer part of the Python test script, including cleanup and closing code.

methods.name: formatValue
methods.description: Formats JavaScript values into Python code representations.

methods.name: formatOptions
methods.description: Formats options objects into Python argument strings.

methods.name: formatContextOptions
methods.description: Formats browser context options into Python code, including device descriptors.
